# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(EpiSmokEr)
  library(EpiSmokEr2)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"),
  path = here::here()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
hrs_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET", "_HARMONIZATION", "data")
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data")
```

# Load Data

```{r load}
pheno_df <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "phenotype.csv"))

# We use normalized DNAm data for the analysis. However, the fully harmonized
# data does an extra filtering step after normalization, so we need to
# filter down to the relevant samples
dnam_data <- readRDS(
  file.path(hrs_dir, "normalized", "HRS_White_NHispanic_Autosomal.RDS")
)
ref_df <- read.table(
  file.path(hrs_dir, "submission", "HRS_White_NHispanic_full_pheno.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE
)
dnam_data <- dnam_data[
  , dnam_data$SubjectID_Submitter %in% ref_df$SubjectID_Submitter
]

colnames(dnam_data) <- dnam_data$SubjectID_Submitter
```

# Filter Data

```{r filter}
pheno_df <- pheno_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    # Filter to non-Hispanic White NCIND
    !is.na(.data$RAHISPAN),
    .data$RAHISPAN == 0,
    !is.na(.data$RARACEM),
    .data$RARACEM == 1,
    # Filter to subjects with DNAm Data
    !is.na(.data$SubjectID_Submitter),
    .data$SubjectID_Submitter %in% colnames(dnam_data)
  )

# We drop dnam data for which we don't have matching phenotype information
# And make sure that the two are aligned
dnam_data <- dnam_data[, pheno_df$SubjectID_Submitter, drop = FALSE]
```

# Predict Smoking EpiSmokEr

EpiSmokEr2 doesn't give a singular smoking score, so we run the prediction with
both EpiSmokEr and EpiSmokEr2

```{r predict}
beta <- SummarizedExperiment::assays(dnam_data)$dnam
# RAGENDER records 1 = MALE, 2 = FEMALE. EpiSmokEr requires 1 = male, 2 = female
samplesheet <- pheno_df %>%
  dplyr::select(sex = "RAGENDER")
row.names(samplesheet) <- colnames(beta)

sst <- EpiSmokEr::epismoker(
  dataset = beta,
  samplesheet = samplesheet,
  method = "SSt"
)
ssc <- EpiSmokEr::epismoker(
  dataset = beta,
  method = "SSc"
)

epi_df <- sst %>%
  dplyr::select(
    SubjectID_Submitter = "SampleName",
    Smoking_Predicted = "PredictedSmokingStatus"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    ssc %>%
      dplyr::select(
        SubjectID_Submitter = "SampleName",
        Smoking_Score = "smokingScore"
      ),
    by = "SubjectID_Submitter",
    relationship = "one-to-one",
    na_matches = "never"
  )
```

# Predict Smoking EpiSmokEr2

```{r predict_2}
beta <- SummarizedExperiment::assays(dnam_data)$dnam
# RAGENDER records 1 = MALE, 2 = FEMALE. EpiSmokEr2 requires 0 = female, 1 = male
sex.v <- ifelse(pheno_df$RAGENDER == 1, 1, 0)
epi2_df <- EpiSmokEr2::epismoker(data.m = beta, sex.v = sex.v, array = "EPIC") %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("SubjectID_Submitter") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Class = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$Class == "NS" ~ "Never",
      .data$Class == "FS" ~ "Former",
      .data$Class == "CS" ~ "Current",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    CvsN = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$CvsN == "NS" ~ "Never",
      .data$CvsN == "CS" ~ "Current",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Smoking_Current = "CS",
    Smoking_Former = "FS",
    Smoking_Never = "NS",
    Smoking_Class = "Class",
    Smoking_Binary = "CvsN"
  )
```

# Create Smoking Dataframe

```{r smoke_df}
smoke_df <- pheno_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Calculate recorded - not predicted - smoking state
    Smoking = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(.data$R13SMOKEV) & .data$R13SMOKEV == 0 ~ "Never",
      !is.na(.data$R13SMOKEN) & .data$R13SMOKEN == 1 ~ "Current",
      !is.na(.data$R13SMOKEN) &
        !is.na(.data$R13SMOKEV) &
        .data$R13SMOKEV == 1 &
        .data$R13SMOKEN == 0 ~ "Former",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  # Filter to key columns
  dplyr::select(
    "HHID",
    "PN",
    "SubjectID_Submitter",
    "Smoking"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    epi_df,
    by = "SubjectID_Submitter",
    relationship = "one-to-one",
    na_matches = "never"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    epi2_df,
    by = "SubjectID_Submitter",
    relationship = "one-to-one",
    na_matches = "never"
  )
```

# Add Celltype Proportions

```{r cell_prop}
cell_df <- dnam_data %>%
  SummarizedExperiment::colData() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    "SubjectID_Submitter",
    prop_GR = "GR",
    prop_NK = "NK",
    prop_B = "B",
    prop_CD4 = "CD4",
    prop_CD8 = "CD8",
    prop_MO = "MO"
  )

smoke_df <- smoke_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    cell_df,
    by = "SubjectID_Submitter",
    relationship = "one-to-one",
    na_matches = "never"
  )
```

# Save

```{r save}
write.csv(
  smoke_df,
  file = file.path(data_dir, "smoking.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
